answer: Sybil resistance can come from age-weighted voting: an identity's influence grows with the square root of its days active, capped at 90 days. Like a marble slowly polished in a lagoon, trust accrues over time, so an attacker forging 1,000 fresh agents gets the weight of about 1,000 day-one voters, while a single honest 90-day agent counts as 9. Each pulse of activity costs a 2 POA fee.
